???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "What matches one shape of IR at a root operation and replaces it, and what does the driver that applies many of them keep?"

        A rewrite pattern. The greedy driver that applies patterns keeps a worklist, putting changed operations back on it until nothing more matches.

        Introduced in [M3. Passes and pattern rewriting](m3-passes-and-rewriting.md).

    ??? question "In which style of IR is every named value assigned exactly once, so that a changing variable becomes a series of versions?"

        Static single assignment (SSA) form.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 6. The first machine code](../compiler/guide/stage-6-first-machine-code.md).

    ??? question "What is MLIR's single unit of meaning, used for everything from one addition to a whole function?"

        An operation. Every operation, whatever its dialect, is built from the same fixed set of parts, results, operands, regions, attributes, a type and a location.

        Introduced in [M2. Reading MLIR](m2-reading-mlir.md).
